Only the planned color fields and product updatedAt are admitted differences. No general metadata/timestamp exception follows. Actual product updatedAt values fall after the applicable calls and before readback; field creation/update timestamps were not queried.

Parent color defaults must be requalified for future different palettes/garment types. Additional feed languages require separate color/landing-language reconciliation. Cobalt, As image and all six existing held parents stay outside scope.

Two sequential successful calls of 25 and 22 fields are distinct atomic calls, not one atomic 47-field transaction. No retry or rollback was performed by this acceptance; absent-before deletion safeguards remain.
Dated claim rebind is accepted from exact saved guard and independent review evidence; no authority for a general guard bypass, source expansion or future write is granted.
Buyer preselection/fit-guide, shipping/returns/cloud-reader work remains separately owned. No all-market eligibility, ratings, traffic, sales or profit result is certified.
